row.evidence: BILL's pricing table lists Single sign-on only on Corporate and Enterprise, and its SSO help article says a user removed from the identity provider simply "won't be able to log into your BILL account"; no SCIM endpoint is documented in BILL's developer docs or help centre.
row.notes: New row. No SCIM: BILL offers SAML 2.0 / OIDC SSO on Corporate ($89/u/mo) and Enterprise, set up by request through an SSO qualification form; removing a user in the IdP only blocks SSO sign-in. Users can be created, updated, archived and restored through the BILL v3 REST API (developer key + session) on every plan ('API access' included on all plans), but no IdP connector using it was found. Prices are as shown on the pricing page (per user/month; billing period not stated). Spend & Expense is a separate $0 product. Duplicate of bill.com in the candidate list (same vendor, slug from a different source list); both rows hold the same research.

plans.name: Spend & Expense
plans.notes: Separate product (cards, budgets, expenses); user API is the Spend & Expense API with an API token.

limitations.text: No SCIM endpoint is documented; the help centre returns no articles for SCIM, and removing a user from the IdP only stops SSO sign-in (the BILL user is not deprovisioned).

scim.notes: scim.available false is by absence: BILL never says no, but neither the developer docs (llms.txt index) nor the help centre document SCIM.

capabilities.notes: Deactivation is 'archive'; reactivation is 'restore'. Roles are assigned via roleId on create/update.

endpoints.purpose: Get list of users (20 per page by default, up to 100)
Create a user (ADMINISTRATOR role; BILL emails the user to finish sign-up)

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhooks exist (event catalog via GET /v3/events/catalog) but the documented payload pages cover vendors, bills, payments, bank/card accounts, invoices and risk verification, not users.

audit_log_api.notes: Per-object audit trail endpoints (e.g. vendor audit trail) exist; no organization-wide user/admin audit-log API was found.

rate_limits.text: 20,000 requests per developer key per hour; login 200 per hour.

okta.notes: OIN search for 'bill.com' and 'divvy' returned no results; 'bill' returned unrelated apps. BILL's SSO itself runs through BILL's own Okta tenant (help article mentions SAML assertions sent to Okta).

entra.notes: No BILL tutorial in the Microsoft Entra SaaS app tutorial index; gallery listing not confirmed.
